newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX Corp Q1 net up, adjusted for pensions.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX Corp Q1 net up, adjusted for pensions.

text.p: NOTE: First Call consensus estimate for Q1 1997 was $0.90 per share.
Adjusted results in both quarters are adjusted for the effects of an enhanced pension offer.
Q1 1997 adjusted results exclude after-tax charges of $243.6 million, or $0.56 per share to cover the approximately 2,900 employees who accepted the enhanced pension offer in the first quarter.
Q1 1996 adjusted results exclude charges of $66.5 million after taxes, or $0.16 per share, for approximately 960 employees who accepted the offer.

Adjusted first quarter 1996 results include gain resulting from a change in accounting for directory advertising revenues and expenses, partially offset by charges for various legal, regulatory and other obligations, resulting in a net gain of $4.0 million after taxes, or $0.01 per share.

Adjusted first quarter 1996 results also include a change in presentation of certain taxes other than income and exclude a one-time after-tax gain of $45.8 million, or $0.11 per share, for sale of NYNEX's interest in Vanstar Corp.

Certain first quarter 1997 results were reclassified to account for charges previously recorded in connection with various legal contingencies and settlements of audits of affiliate transactions and sales taxes.
EBITDA refers to operating income plus depreciation and amortization.
